card: This PR mechanically adds `#include <util/check.h>` and removes redundant `<cassert>` includes across test, fuzz, and benchmark files. It addresses ambiguity around assertion semantics, prevents compile errors when assertions are configured differently in `util/check.h`, and facilitates Include-What-You-Use (IWYU) tooling. A minor CI change allows `clang-format` during scripted-diff verification to keep headers sorted. The change affects only test code and lint tooling, posing no risk to runtime behavior.
changed_since_previous: Rebased onto newer master commits with updated diff lines; the approach and commit structure remain unchanged.
evidence: Commit fa8c454885 notes: "The project has a compile error when compiled without assertions in util/check.h. Thus, util/check.h should be included for all assertions."
PR description states: "Avoid that confusion in test code with a scripted replacement to add the util/check.h include. The changes here will also make it easier to run IWYU."
problem: Assertions in test code often rely on transitive includes or standard `<cassert>`, creating confusion over whether `NDEBUG` disables assertions and triggering compile errors under certain assertion build configurations. Transitive includes also complicate Include-What-You-Use (IWYU) analysis.

risk.why: Touches only test header includes and CI linting scripts via scripted diffs, with any missing header caught at compile time.

scope_notes: Large mechanical scripted diff spanning 153 files, exclusively modifying include directives in test, fuzz, and benchmark files alongside a minor CI lint script adjustment.
summary: Adds explicit `#include <util/check.h>` and removes redundant `<cassert>` includes across unit test, fuzz, and benchmark code via scripted diffs. It also adjusts CI linting configuration to allow `clang-format` during scripted-diff verification in order to sort the updated include blocks.
